gripOrHq.title: Washington, D.C., City Grid
gripOrHq.rulesText:
The difficulty of agendas installed inside this fort is reduced by 1.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

gripOrHq.title: ACME Savings and Loan
gripOrHq.rulesText: Rezzing ACME S&L costs 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. When you rez ACME S&L, gain [12] and trash ACME S&L. For the remainder of the game, pay [1] at the end of each of your turns, or lose the game. You can remove this effect, and score 1 agenda point, by taking an action to pay [12].

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: Romp through HQ
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ; you may trash, at no cost, any cards you access that were stored in HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: Custodial Position
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If successful, access two additional cards from R&D.

rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

ice.title: Vacuum Link
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.
